nijitrack ac76c322aedd62740eee01c3ea1c528f7de51f6c
https://github.com/nijigenerate/nijitrack
Source archive SHA256: bb5f1f25f8d1849f9bee94d9858fdc96bbe84249bcc8d1c7b06762824cea916d

Windows and macOS build the MediaPipe/Halide SDK from this pinned source.
Windows: native/scripts/setup_tracking_toolchain.ps1,
prepare_mediapipe_halide.ps1 and build_mediapipe_halide.ps1.
macOS: native/build.sh setup, prepare and sdk.

MediaPipe 6d31f1ebc3284db74d211d62bdc4f0a0c29ea120
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
Face/hand C API, static build with OpenCV disabled.
Windows uses clang-cl and the static MSVC CRT (/MT).
Halide 15.0.1 provides the upstream arbitrary-angle ROI implementation.
Pinned tools and sources are verified by the upstream toolchain locks and recipe.

Local Windows script patch enables only the Bazel compiler action cache.
Local macOS script patch selects the installed SDK and enables analysis preflight.
No prebuilt tracker SDK is vendored or downloaded.
Generated SDK provenance and transitive licenses are installed from build outputs.
Task bundles retain their own models/models.lock.json.
